lgrc-gad.title: MSAC
lgrc-gad.description:
Municipal Services Advisory Committee (MSAC)

The Municipal Services Advisory Committee (MSAC) is an advisory body established to ensure effective and efficient delivery of municipal services to the people.

MSAC serves as a bridge between the government and the community, facilitating:

  • Consultations on municipal service delivery
  • Community feedback and suggestions
  • Monitoring of government performance
  • Advocacy for improved public services

Through MSAC, we aim to create a more responsive and accountable local government that truly serves the needs of its constituents.
